dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular and crenulated outer perimeters composed of high-intensity pixels surrounding darker interior cores; observed 3-5 prominent 'O' and 'C' shapes exhibit non-uniform edge thickness and sharp pixel-level gradients at the dark-to-light boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels are concentrated at the convergence points of the macro-annuli boundaries, while low-intensity pixel cores are centrally located within the primary annular structures, showing a moderate spatial density across the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-proximal annular structures form an obtuse scalene triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the torso, with a secondary cluster of smaller centroids forming a linear chain extending towards the posterior.
